continuationReal.$comment: Read by json_get_or_register: a JSON real, or an array of JSON reals. An integer, string (no constants lookup for the scalar form), boolean or object aborts (continuation_scheduler.f90:160); array elements must be reals (case_file_utils.f90:347 in Neko); an empty array reads values(1) of a zero-size array (continuation_scheduler.f90:153).
continuationReal.description: A real, or a non-empty array of reals stepped through by the continuation scheduler.

continuationIterations.$comment: Read with json_get_or_default (integer variant): a JSON integer, no constants lookup (continuation_scheduler.f90:155). Values <= 0 are accepted and disable the schedule (continuation_scheduler.f90:248).

pointZoneName.$comment: Passed to the point-zone registry as is; an empty string means no mask (sources/problem/objective.f90:151).
